in_marathi.name: Satnarayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satnarayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sat means truth and Narayan means the one who protects and preserves. The name Satnarayan signifies the God who is the embodiment of truth and the one who protects and preserves.
